```mcstas
# McStas instrument file for SESANS setup

instrument SESANS

# Define parameters
parameter L0 = 2.165
parameter DL = 0.02
parameter By = 4.68e-3

# Components
component Progress_bar
    type Progress_bar
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.01
        yheight = 0.01
        zdepth = 0.01
    end parameters
end component

component Source_simple
    type Source_simple
    parameters
        yheight = 0.01
        xwidth = 0.01
        dist = 2.25
        focus_xw = 0.01
        focus_yh = 0.01
        lambda0 = L0
        dlambda = DL
        gauss = 1
    end parameters
end component

component Set_pol
    type Set_pol
    parameters
        px = 1
    end parameters
end component

component PolLambda_monitor
    type PolLambda_monitor
    parameters
        nL = 501
        restore_neutron = 1
        filename = "pxAfterAnalyser"
        mx = 1
        Lmin = L0 - DL
        Lmax = L0 + DL
    end parameters
end component

component Foil_flipper_magnet
    type Foil_flipper_magnet
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.1
        yheight = 0.1
        zdepth = 0.3
        phi = 0.095993
        foilthick = 3.0
        Bx = 0
        By = By
        Bz = 0
        foil_in = 1
        verbose = 0
    end parameters
end component

component SANS_spheres2
    type SANS_spheres2
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.02
        yheight = 0.02
        zthick = 0.001
        dsdw_inc = 0.0
        sc_aim = 0.8
        sans_aim = 0.95
        R = 10000
        phi = 0.015
        singlesp = 0
        Qmind = 0.00003
        Qmaxd = 0.001
    end parameters
end component

component PSD_monitor
    type PSD_monitor
    parameters
        nx = 101
        ny = 101
        filename = "det"
        xwidth = 0.011
        yheight = 0.011
    end parameters
end component

component Arm
    type Arm
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.011
        yheight = 0.011
        zdepth = 0.011
    end parameters
    code
        RESTORE_NEUTRON(INDEX_CURRENT_COMP-2,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,t,sx,sy,sz,p);
    end code
end component

# Beamline components
component origin
    type Progress_bar
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.01
        yheight = 0.01
        zdepth = 0.01
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0
end component

component src
    type Source_simple
    parameters
        yheight = 0.01
        xwidth = 0.01
        dist = 2.25
        focus_xw = 0.01
        focus_yh = 0.01
        lambda0 = L0
        dlambda = DL
        gauss = 1
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.1
    relative_to origin
end component

component set_pol
    type Set_pol
    parameters
        px = 1
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.1
    relative_to src
end component

component px1
    type PolLambda_monitor
    parameters
        nL = 501
        restore_neutron = 1
        filename = "pxAfterAnalyser"
        mx = 1
        Lmin = L0 - DL
        Lmax = L0 + DL
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.01
    relative_to set_pol
end component

component f1
    type Foil_flipper_magnet
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.1
        yheight = 0.1
        zdepth = 0.3
        phi = 0.095993
        foilthick = 3.0
        Bx = 0
        By = By
        Bz = 0
        foil_in = 1
        verbose = 0
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.5
    relative_to src
end component

component px2
    type PolLambda_monitor
    parameters
        nL = 501
        restore_neutron = 1
        filename = "pxAfterAnalyser"
        mx = 1
        Lmin = L0 - DL
        Lmax = L0 + DL
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.16
    relative_to f1
end component

component f2
    type Foil_flipper_magnet
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.1
        yheight = 0.1
        zdepth = 0.3
        phi = 0.095993
        foilthick = 3.0
        Bx = 0
        By = By
        Bz = 0
        foil_in = 1
        verbose = 0
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 2.0
    relative_to src
end component

component px3
    type PolLambda_monitor
    parameters
        nL = 501
        restore_neutron = 1
        filename = "pxAfterAnalyser"
        mx = 1
        Lmin = L0 - DL
        Lmax = L0 + DL
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.16
    relative_to f2
end component

component sans_spheres
    type SANS_spheres2
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.02
        yheight = 0.02
        zthick = 0.001
        dsdw_inc = 0.0
        sc_aim = 0.8
        sans_aim = 0.95
        R = 10000
        phi = 0.015
        singlesp = 0
        Qmind = 0.00003
        Qmaxd = 0.001
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 2.25
    relative_to src
end component

component f3
    type Foil_flipper_magnet
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.1
        yheight = 0.1
        zdepth = 0.3
        phi = 0.095993
        foilthick = 3.0
        Bx = 0
        By = By
        Bz = 0
        foil_in = 1
        verbose = 0
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 2.5
    relative_to src
end component

component f4
    type Foil_flipper_magnet
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.1
        yheight = 0.1
        zdepth = 0.3
        phi = 0.095993
        foilthick = 3.0
        Bx = 0
        By = By
        Bz = 0
        foil_in = 1
        verbose = 0
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 4.0
    relative_to src
end component

component px6
    type PolLambda_monitor
    parameters
        nL = 501
        restore_neutron = 1
        filename = "pxAfterAnalyser"
        mx = 1
        Lmin = L0 - DL
        Lmax = L0 + DL
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.16
    relative_to f4
end component

component ana
    type PolAnalyser_ideal
    parameters
        mx = 1
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 4.4
    relative_to src
end component

component det
    type PSD_monitor
    parameters
        nx = 101
        ny = 101
        filename = "det"
        xwidth = 0.011
        yheight = 0.011
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 4.5
    relative_to src
end component

component trick
    type Arm
    parameters
        xwidth = 0.011
        yheight = 0.011
        zdepth = 0.011
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 4.4
    relative_to src
end component

component ana2
    type PolAnalyser_ideal
    parameters
        mx = -1
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 4.4
    relative_to src
end component

component det2
    type PSD_monitor
    parameters
        nx = 101
        ny = 101
        filename = "det2"
        xwidth = 0.011
        yheight = 0.011
    end parameters
    position x = 0, y = 0, z = 4.5
    relative_to src
end component

# Link components
origin -> src
src -> set_pol
set_pol -> px1
src -> f1
f1 -> px2
src -> f2
f2 -> px3
src -> sans_spheres
src -> f3
src -> f4
f4 -> px6
src -> ana
src -> det
src -> trick
src -> ana2
src -> det2

# Simulation parameters
run
    ncount = 1e6
    seed = 123456789
    wait_s = 0
end run

# Output
print
    monitor px1
    monitor px2
    monitor px3
    monitor sans_spheres
    monitor det
    monitor det2
end print
